No, this is not accurate. There is no legal requirement for EU/EFTA cross-border commuters to return home every day to live in specific border zones. Cross-border commuters can live in their own country and commute to work in Switzerland according to bilateral agreements between Switzerland and the EU/EFTA.

However, there are administrative requirements in place. For instance, employees must have a valid work permit and be registered with the relevant authorities. Additionally, employers must comply with Swiss labor regulations. For EU/EFTA citizens, the rules are generally governed by the bilateral agreements which allow for freedom of movement for workers.

If you're considering working in Switzerland as a cross-border commuter, it’s advisable to consult official sources such as the Swiss Immigration Office or the Swiss embassy to get the most accurate and up-to-date information.
